normal_AC_control_rule: select within jointly feasible given usual comfort setting;keep setpoint,duration and realized air-temperature semantics separate;do not inherit uniform26C blindly
B_rule: same world,need and hardware as frozen A;request differences and permission/service consequences separate;retain bad counterfactual B;no human acceptance label
hardware_rule: retain existing original EB engineering parameter pack;type controls usage/service and permissions,not arbitrary COP/power
physical_equivalence_rule: different role policies may evaluate the same physical A/B differently;do not manufacture load differences for clustering
unknown_preservation: employment unknown stays unknown;source work proxies and any new activity/care/charging scenario explicitly graded;no preference inferred from demographics
population_frame_open_item: nonadult-only households need explicit policy-holder/guardian/source-frame reconciliation;no silent age editing or dropping
